reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `leaderboard-sort` vs `main`:

• *Score precision breaks ranking* — `src/rank.js:3` subtracts decimal-string scores, implicitly converting them to Numbers. Scores above 2^53 can collapse into ties and return the wrong winner, including through `topN()`.
  *Reproduced:* input scores `9007199254740992`, then `9007199254740993`, leave the lower score ranked first; `topN(entries, 1)` selects it.
  *Recommended fix:* use the existing exact comparator: `.sort((a, b) => compareScore(b.score, a.score))`. Add regression tests for both ranking and top-N with these scores.

All 3 existing tests pass, but `test/rank.test.js` only exercises small scores. No other findings. No code changed.
